[[Brejik]] made his own '''personal gloves''' which were designed to enhance the hand-[[Eye/Legends|eye]] coordination of the wearer. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] took these gloves after he and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]] killed Brejik in the fight that ensued at the end of the [[Tarisian Season Opener]].
